projects.name: Ballast Re
projects.description:
Ballast Re is an RWA yield-bearing stablecoin vault backed by real-world reinsurance contracts. Reinsurance (insurance for insurers) is a $750B+ industry starved for capital. Ballast Re opens this closed market onchain with sustainable, uncorrelated, safe 6%+ yields. Team: 30+ years across insurance and DeFi, incl. fmr CEO of a major reinsurer plus AXA Ventures and Goldman Sachs alumni. $30M LP and 10+ vault partners committed.

How it works:

We issue baUSD, a yield-bearing stablecoin backed by regulated US casualty specialty reinsurance treaties, targeting 6%+ APY with zero crypto, equity, or rate correlation. $300B+ in stablecoins sits idle while casualty reinsurance faces its tight capacity with prices rising 5-10%/quarter. Ballast Re connects the two: depositors get baUSD, capital flows to our Bermuda Class 3A SAC reinsurer, and underwriting profit flows back to holders. Unlike T-bill or lending yield (2-4%), baUSD yield comes from insurance premium: no cat exposure, modeled attritional losses, principal protected by a collateral waterfall incl. Reg 114 Trust reserves.

A Liquity v2-style CDP protocol on Stellar lets users mint ☆USD (placeholder), a decentralized overcollateralized stablecoin, using XLM and other blue-chip assets as collateral.  

For borrowers, it offers fixed-rate, open-term USD credit. Rates are set by the user or via interest rate managers; they can be changed anytime. If a rate is too low, positions can be redeemed using collateral value, with no loss to the borrower. Historically, this model delivers cheaper fixed rates than dynamic-rate markets, Morpho-style fixed-rate orderbooks, and rate swaps, without repayment deadlines.

  
For yield seekers, returns come from borrower interest and liquidation gains. The Stability Pool earns a share of interest and buys collateral at a discount during liquidations. DEX LPs earn interest share, trading fees, and incentives.

  
For Stellar, this unlocks yield on XLM by enabling carry trades by borrowing ☆USD and deploying into Stability/DEX pools, making idle XLM productive. ☆USD acts as native liquidity for future lending, trading use cases, and scalable collateral expansion.

projects.name: LumenWipe
projects.description:
LumenWipe closes a Stellar account and recovers its locked XLM reserves. It handles every step automatically: signer normalization, data entry removal, DEX offer cancellation, LP withdrawal, DeFi position exits (Blend, Aquarius, Soroswap, Phoenix, FxDAO), asset conversion, trustline removal, and the final account merge.

The project responds to the Account Demolisher RFP. It extends the public-domain stellar.expert/demolisher/public by Orbit Lens with the piece that tool lacks: full Soroban and DeFi parity. Any account with a Blend loan, an Aquarius LP position, or a Soroswap pair share cannot be closed with any existing tool today.

All transactions are built and signed in the browser. The backend is read-only and stateless, never in the signing path. A transparent mediator account handles CEX destinations, since no major exchange supports ACCOUNT_MERGE. A read-only allowance inspector lets users revoke token approvals without closing their account.

The classic wind-down runs on testnet and mainnet today.

projects.name: Octarine
projects.description:
Tokenized RWAs, such as funds, T-Bills or private credit products, are difficult to trade on traditional DEXs because they are regulated, fragmented and often include redemption periods. This lack of instant liquidity limits their use in DeFi, especially for lending market liquidations, margin calls or fast exits from a RWA into a stablecoin.

Octarine solves this problem through RFQ-based auctions. When a user or protocol needs liquidity, selected liquidity providers compete to offer the best executable price. The winning LP takes the asset, waits for its redemption period and earns a premium, while the user receives immediate liquidity. Octarine can also accept bids from third-party protocols and structure dedicated liquidity facilities, increasing available depth and price quality without leaving capital idle.

On Stellar, Octarine aims to deploy this liquidity layer for tokenized assets and enable faster and deeper secondary RWA markets.
